The park is about a fifteen-minute drive from the nearby town of [[Kurri Kurri]] via the Sawyers Gully Road and Old Maitland Road. If you're coming from [[Newcastle (New South Wales)|Newcastle]], then use the M15 Hunter Expressway and then exit onto Main Road.
